newsitem.title: USA: Nintendo games feature Disney characters.
newsitem.headline: Nintendo games feature Disney characters.

text.p: Subsidiaries of Nintendo Co Ltd and Walt Disney Co said they will team up to offer three video games in time for the holiday shopping season.
Disney Interactive has licensed the games to Nintendo of America Inc, which will market them for the 16-bit Super Nintendo Entertainment System.

A spokesman for Nintendo said the move was an indication that the video-game giant intends to support the 5-year-old SNES system even as it prepares to roll out the next-generation Nintendo 64 machine.
The new Disney games include "Maui Mallard in Cold Shadow" and "Pinocchio," which will be available exclusively for the Nintendo platform in November.
Nintendo also will rerelease a version of Disney's "Toy Story" for sale beginning in October.
The games carry a suggested retail price of $59.95.
